notes.title: The Islander: Town Architect is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31851079/ea69fd3ebeec2e4743e9c46d32e80e2a3183144c.png[/img]

Hello islanders,

We just wanted to let you know that our new game and sequel to The Islander - [b]The Islander: Town Architect is finally released on Steam[/b], so  head to calm & exotic Polynesia to become a grand-master town architect.  To celebrate this occasion the game is 10% off.

You can get it here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1042160/

[h1]FEATURES[/h1]
[b]Design house exterior[/b] - choose the building type, elect the wanted roof and walls design, make sure windows and doors fits the overall look of the house, or go wild and create craziest designs.

[b]Don't limit yourself to house designing only, landscape your town[/b], after all you are TOWN ARCHITECT. Build pathways and fences, plant trees and shrubs, erect statues and fountains.

[b]Expand and urbanize your island[/b] by building stores, agricultural and public buildings, like - libraries, tower bells and observatories.

[b]Sizable catalog of items and decorations[/b] ranging from flowers and bushes to lighthouses and pyramids.

[b]Relaxing atmosphere[/b] to ease your stressed-out mind.

[h1]SCREENSHOTS[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31851079/4c48789cac9d9afcc97501da4e592baea64e47a6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31851079/3ed9b1ac727106613208600b0e370975255021ab.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31851079/01cf6dc0f3605b64278851ab630f6c8026effe91.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31851079/20b2943a8a31ba5b7aed073da9cb3255cacb73e1.png[/img]

- Boxhead Bros.

notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
Hey there,

-The Islander is finally available in Russian! Thanks to Quton for providing translation.
-We also added an additional Display option, that allows to expand window size when playing in windowed mode.

More updates coming really soon.

7 Box Games

-v.1.0.2.0.
